title_zh: 免費網上研討會：用身體工具建立獲得性安全依附
title_en: Free Webinar: Creating Earned Secure Attachment with Somatic Tools
summary_zh: 這場免費線上工作坊教治療師用身體取向框架，幫助個案把安全依附變成身體經驗。課程不只談理論，會帶體驗式練習。適合處理發展性創傷與不安全依附的臨床工作者。
summary_en: Free one-hour virtual workshop (14 Oct 2026, 12–1pm ET) on helping clients move from insight to embodied secure attachment using three body-based techniques; 1 CE hour for several US licences.

ethics_flags.note: 身體取向創傷介入需要相應訓練，1 小時免費課不等於完整訓練。

caution: CE 學分限特定美國執照，港澳不一定承認；主講之一為身體教練而非持照心理師。
brief_zh: 主講 Ramona Ndlovu（LMFT）與 Rebecca Bromberg（身體取向教練）
學習解釋獲得性安全依附的三個元素，並練習三種身體取向技巧
1 小時 CE，適用 NBCC、賓州社工、LPC、LMFT、心理師；需用 Google 表單報名
supervision_questions: 個案「懂了依附理論卻仍重複舊模式」時，身體取向介入如何與督導中的個案概念化對接？
運用身體技巧前，如何確認個案同意與穩定化條件？

training.ce_credits: 1 CE Hour for NBCC, PA SW, LPC, LMFT, and Psychologists
training.provider: Phoenix Center for Experiential Trauma Therapy
training.topic: 以身體取向工具建立獲得性安全依附

posts.author_name: Phoenix Center for Experiential Trauma Therapy
posts.title: Free Webinar: Creating Earned Secure Attachment with Somatic Tools
posts.content: Phoenix Center 舉辦的免費線上工作坊，用身體取向框架幫助個案把安全依附變成身體經驗，含體驗式練習。

related.summary_zh: NOCD Academy 的免費直播 CE 課，由 Sara Conley 博士主講。內容聚焦兒童焦慮的症狀辨識與評估，完成可獲 2 學分，仍可報名。
related.summary_en: NOCD Academy free live CE webinar on 14 Oct 2026 by Sara Conley, PhD, on symptoms and assessment of childhood anxiety; 2 CE credits.

related.title_zh: Pat Ogden 免費錄影講座：感覺動作心理治療談創傷下的復原力
related.title_en: Free Pat Ogden webinar on resilience amid trauma
related.summary_zh: Leading Edge Seminars 與 Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute（SPI）、SensorimotorItalia.it 合作，免費公開 Pat Ogden 與 Rebeca Farca 的錄影講座「Building Resilience in Times of War, Violence & Other Traumatic Events」。內容介紹如何協助長期處於壓力與威脅下的案主，並附講義、給案主用的 PEACE protocol 與給臨床人員的 SPI protocol 可下載。
related.summary_en: Leading Edge Seminars, with the Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute and SensorimotorItalia.it, offers a free recorded webinar by Pat Ogden and Rebeca Farca, 'Building Resilience in Times of War, Violence & Other Traumatic Events'. It shows how to help clients living with long-term stress and threat, with a downloadable handout, a PEACE protocol for clients and an SPI protocol for clinicians.

training.provider: Leading Edge Seminars（與 Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute 合作）

related.title_zh: 強化客觀觀察者：治療中的反思實務
related.summary_zh: eiseEducation 的免費網上講座（雪梨時間 2026-10-07 晚上 6:30–8:00，講者 Zern Liew），探討治療師如何在同理投入與客觀觀察之間取得平衡，涵蓋自我監察、偏見辨識與批判思考。直播免費；錄影或 60 天回看需付 $19；出席達 80% 可得 1.5 小時 CPD。
related.summary_en: Free live webinar by eiseEducation (7 Oct 2026, 6:30–8pm Sydney time) with Zern Liew on balancing empathic engagement with reflective detachment: self-monitoring, bias recognition and critical thinking. 1.5 CPD hours with 80% attendance.
